snippet.title: Harventure - Demo Launch Trailer (LIVE NOW!)
snippet.description:
Play on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4140980/Harventure_Demo/

Harvest, collect and upgrade! Harventure is a short incremental game about harvesting and using resources on upgrades to purify islands from corruption.
